violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register an employee certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application provided during the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. Establishment is to consistently date shellfish tags with the last date of service. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the 2-door reach-in. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/05/2026

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed to date shellfish tags when finished. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2025
